overview_description.description: Housewarming is a social media app that lets friends share casual daily moments with each other. The app focuses on friends-only sharing rather than public broadcasting, aiming to support communication among existing close contacts. It uses AI features to support the experience while avoiding feeds driven by advertising or opaque recommendation algorithms. Housewarming removes pressure to post highlights by centering quick, live camera-based sharing and simple updates from everyday life. The product is intended for consumers who want a low-pressure way to keep up with people they already know. It offers tools to capture and view casual moments in a straightforward interface that prioritizes direct social interaction.
